LanguageData.GrechkaCameraPlus_Intro: Extended map camera zoom. Use the usual mouse wheel and zoom keys.
LanguageData.GrechkaCameraPlus_Closer: Zoom in beyond the vanilla limit: ×{0}
LanguageData.GrechkaCameraPlus_Farther: Zoom out beyond the vanilla limit: ×{0}
LanguageData.GrechkaCameraPlus_Help: Changes apply when you return to the map. Set a factor to ×1 to restore that vanilla limit. The world camera is unchanged. Zooming far out displays more objects and may reduce FPS.
